title: playbook locate --json
description: The step a quote names in the computed family, the files that wrote the quoted words, and the user file an edit to them belongs in.

stem.description: A playbook file's stem: a bundled playbook's, a team file's or a user file's.

kind.description: pstack for a bundled playbook, team for a file in the checkout's .agents/playbooks, user for a file in the config dir.

step.description: The step's number in the computed playbook.

text.description: The step's text after every member's edits.

origin.description: The file that wrote the step.

writers.description: The files that wrote the quoted words, less any that another writer descends from. A new edit must extend all of them to see the words.

path.description: The user file the edit goes in.

own.description: True when a single user file wrote the words, so the change goes in its own text instead of an edit line.

extends.description: The parents the file must list. null when own is true.
